report.title: Wrong text on Transfer Complete! page
report.summary: The page shows 'Transfer Complete!' instead of 'Transfer Done!' when a transfer is successful. This is a bug in the application.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Log in to the ParaBank website
2. Go to the Transfer Funds page
3. Transfer $10 from one account to another
report.expected: The page should show 'Transfer Done!' when a transfer is successful
report.actual: The page shows 'Transfer Complete!' when a transfer is successful
evidence: Locator expected to have text 'Transfer Done!' Actual value: Transfer Complete!
report.suspected_cause: The application's text is not consistent with its expected behavior.
report.next_action: The development team should review the application's text and behavior to ensure consistency.
